definitions.explanation: The portrayal of a character in theater, film, etc.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{演技|えんぎ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{素晴|すば}らしい→素晴らしい：01119_subarashii⟧。
{演技|えんぎ}{力|りょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{演技|えんぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: The acting in this movie is very good.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{演技|えんぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧していた。
examples.english: She was pretending to be sick.

notes:
{演技|えんぎ} refers to acting or performance.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {演技|えんぎ}する (to act, to perform)
- {演技|えんぎ}{力|りょく} (acting ability)
- {演技|えんぎ}{派|は} (method actor)
- {演技|えんぎ}{賞|しょう} (acting award)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {演技|えんぎ}: acting (theatrical skill)
- {演奏|えんそう}: musical performance
- {公演|こうえん}: public performance/show
